name: GitHub Repo Tracker
author: David (Deuce) Bigelow
description: Tracks GitHub release download totals for your own and third-party repos, with weekly sparklines, trend-colored lines and a normalized compare view. Repos are split into 'mine' and 'others' categories, cached per-repo to JSON and refreshed weekly from the GitHub API.

barWidget.description: Aggregate GitHub release downloads with a weekly trend line; click for details and compare.
